output: html_document
---

Changes in new version in 2026

1. The delta method for variance calculation is now much faster, and
is the recommended method.

2. It is now possible to report design-based or model-based estimates in any 
aggregation desired. For example, you could estimate design-based estimators
at the scale of one set of spatial areas (e.g. national statistical areas), 
and report by a different set of spatial areas (e.g. ICCAT statistical areas). 
The existing variable `groupVar` in `bycatchDesign` may now be a character vector 
giving the variables to group over. See user guide for details.

3. If the user inputs column names for latitude and latitude (or northing and easting)
along with a number for the size of desired spatial bins (e.g. 1 degree by 1 degree),
maps summarizing the total and observed effort, and catches of the target species
are plotted in `bycatchSetup`

4. Code that worked last year should still work. Please contact ebabcock@miami.edu
with any issues.
